title: GPT-6.2 Astra assists a field-exclusion proof for a weighted Lucas sum
summary: The preprint reports that a weighted reciprocal sum of even-indexed Lucas numbers lies outside the quadratic field generated by the square root of five. It extends the irrationality claim across positive integer strides.
ai_technology: OpenAI Codex with GPT-6.2 Astra Max

evidence.tested: Source-reported exact certificates and computational replays support parts of the proof.
evidence.unknown: The submitting author reports understanding only parts of the proof. Independent review and priority were not established.
evidence.ai_role: The submitting author credits Codex with developing the mathematical argument and describes directing the inquiry.
